name: MINECRAFT PREŽIVLJAVANJE OSVETA
overview: In this legendary 13-episode Minecraft web series, the popular YouTuber KingsOfFailsShow (Marko KOFS) embarks on an unforgettable survival journey. Set in his famous survival world, the story follows the adventures of Marko and his loyal companion Daruda. Together, they must navigate dangerous environments, build their base, and face high-stakes challenges as they try to thwart the sinister plans of the Prince of Darkness and his agents. Combining high-energy action, creative building, and Marko's signature comedic commentary, this short-lived but highly memorable series has become an iconic piece of Balkan gaming culture.
